title: CORE-7027 · Review-card Trustpilot/Google logos served below display size
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7027](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7027/rf-shared-review-card-trustpilotgoogle-logos-served-below-display-size) · state `In Progress` · priority P4

## Ticket (verbatim from Linear)

## Impacted pages (35 — same widget as [CORE-7026](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7026/rf-shared-trustpilot-and-google-review-cards-missing-hover-state))

**FAQ pages (24):** `/faqs` · `/faqs/after-company-formation` · `/faqs/annual-accounts` · `/faqs/basics` · `/faqs/company-meetings-and-resolutions` · `/faqs/company-names` · `/faqs/company-records-and-registers` · `/faqs/company-secretary` · `/faqs/confirmation-statement` · `/faqs/corporation-tax` · `/faqs/directors` · `/faqs/directors-service-address` · `/faqs/limited-by-guarantee` · `/faqs/limited-by-shares` · `/faqs/limited-liability-partnerships` · `/faqs/paye-and-payroll` · `/faqs/paying-yourself-through-limited-company` · `/faqs/pscs` · `/faqs/registered-office` · `/faqs/sail-address` · `/faqs/self-assessment` · `/faqs/shares-and-shareholders` · `/faqs/the-formation-process` · `/faqs/vat`

**Service pages (11):** `/business-telephone/` · `/company-dissolution/` · `/company-name-change/` · `/confirmation-statement-service/` · `/director-appointment-resignation/` · `/dormant-company-accounts/` · `/ico-registration/` · `/issue-of-shares/` · `/psc-filing/` · `/transfer-of-shares/` · `/vat-registration/`

Measured directly on `/faqs/company-names`, `/faqs/company-meetings-and-resolutions`, `/faqs/limited-by-shares`, `/faqs/after-company-formation`, `/faqs/company-secretary`, `/faqs/self-assessment`, `/faqs/the-formation-process` and all 11 service pages — byte-identical masters and ratios everywhere; the remaining FAQ pages use the same shared component.

**Component:** "How we are rated" reviews widget — the Trustpilot and Google **logo images** inside the cards
**Breakpoints:** All (360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800) — the logo renders at 200×50 at every width, so the shortfall is identical at all four

---

## Issue

The clone serves the review-card logos from masters **smaller than the size they are displayed at**, so the browser upscales them and they render soft/fuzzy. Live serves each logo at or above its display size.

## Expected (Live) vs Actual (Clone)

| Logo | Rendered at | Live master | Clone master | Result |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Trustpilot | 200×50 | **200×50** (1:1) | **156×39** | Clone upscales **1.28×** — visibly soft |
| Google | 200×50 | **400×135** (2×, retina-crisp) | **200×67** | Clone has no retina headroom; softer than live on high-DPR screens |

The card box, logo box (200×50), star row and rating text are unchanged — this is purely the master image resolution.

## Definition of Done

* Trustpilot logo served at **≥ 200×50**, and not upscaled from a smaller master.
* Google logo served at live's **2× equivalent (400×135)** so it stays crisp on high-DPR screens.
* Applies to the widget on **every** page listed above, not just the examples shown.
* Logo rendered box stays 200×50 — no change to logo size or position.
* Star row, rating text, review count and card spacing remain unchanged.
* No regression to the widget layout at any breakpoint.

## Related

* Same widget as [CORE-7009](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7009/rf-shared-how-we-are-rated-review-stars-render-largerheavier-than-live) (star glyph renders larger/heavier) and [CORE-7026](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7026/rf-shared-trustpilot-and-google-review-cards-missing-hover-state) (cards missing hover state) — separate defects in the same component.
* Same class of issue as [CORE-7013](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7013/rf-shared-faq-banner-image-low-resolution-pixelated) (FAQ banner low-resolution) but a different asset, so tracked separately.

## Evidence

**Trustpilot logo at 4× zoom — the clearest view of the difference.** Live's letter edges and star are crisp (200×50 master at 200×50); the clone's are soft because a 156×39 master is stretched to 200×50.

Measured with Playwright (`naturalWidth`/`naturalHeight` vs rendered box) at all four breakpoints on both sites; the logo renders 200×50 at every width, so the shortfall does not vary by breakpoint.

Ratios confirmed identical across every page listed under **Impacted pages**:

| Logo | Display box | Live natural | Clone natural |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Trustpilot | 200×50 | 200×50 (1.0×) | **156×39 (0.78× — upscaled)** |
| Google | 200×50 | 400×135 (2.0×) | **200×67 (1.0×)** |

---
### Planning note
Third defect in the same "How we are rated" widget — serialized behind the other two on file-conflict grounds. Likely a CMS/media fix (re-upload masters at ≥ display size) rather than a code change; confirm which before editing code.

---
### Routing note (Planning)
`rapid-formations-clone` has **no clone engine** — no `walk-dom-cdp.ts` / `emit-block.ts` /
`verify-clone.ts`, and zero `*Clone` blocks. Every block here is hand-authored, so the
engine-first rule has nothing to diagnose into: this is a **direct fix in the block that
has the defect**. That is why the task is tagged `bug` — it is NOT a fidelity loophole.

**Ship path:** Mode X — `clone-pull-request-create` with per-breakpoint PROD-vs-clone
screenshot proof, land `awaiting-user`, **the USER merges the PR**. Never merge to main.
Live source of truth: `https://www.rapidformations.co.uk` · clone:
`https://rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app`. ⛔ HEADED browser only for any visual check.
